result1 = await create_worktree(..., role=role1, mode=mode1)

property_tests.description: For any call to create_worktree() where effective_mode resolves to None, the path equals the 2-level path and the branch equals feature/{spec_name}/{task_group}, regardless of the effective_role value.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate arbitrary role values (None, '', 'coder', 'reviewer', random strings) combined with mode values that resolve to None (None or ''). Use hypothesis with text() strategies for role and spec_name, integers for task_group.

property_tests.description: For any successful call to create_worktree(), WorkspaceInfo.role reflects the normalised effective_role (None when mode is absent, 'unknown' when mode is present but role was absent) and WorkspaceInfo.mode reflects effective_mode.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Enumerate representative combinations: (None, None), ('', ''), ('reviewer', 'drift-review'), (None, 'drift-review'), ('reviewer', None), ('', 'drift-review'). Use stub git CLI.
property_tests.invariant_check:
cases = [
    (None, None, None, None),
    ('', '', None, None),
    ('reviewer', 'drift-review', 'reviewer', 'drift-review'),
    (None, 'drift-review', 'unknown', 'drift-review'),
    ('reviewer', None, None, None),
    ('', 'drift-review', 'unknown', 'drift-review'),
]
for role, mode, expected_role, expected_mode in cases:
    result = await create_worktree(repo_root='/tmp/repo', spec_name='spec', task_group=0, base_branch='main', role=role, mode=mode)
    assert result.role == expected_role
    assert result.mode == expected_mode

property_tests.invariant_check:
for spec_name, task_group in [('spec_a', 0), ('spec_b', 1), ('spec-c', 99)]:
    info = WorkspaceInfo(
        path=Path(f'/tmp/worktrees/{spec_name}/{task_group}'),
        branch=f'feature/{spec_name}/{task_group}',
        spec_name=spec_name,
        task_group=task_group
